headword: {森林伐採|しんりんばっさい}

definitions.explanation: The clearing or cutting down of forests, especially on a large scale.

examples.japanese: {森林伐採|しんりんばっさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧な{森林伐採|しんりんばっさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まる→取り締まる：06163_torishimaru⟧。
examples.english: To crack down on illegal logging.

examples.japanese: {森林伐採|しんりんばっさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える→影響を与える：26072_eikyouwoataeru⟧。
examples.english: Deforestation has serious impacts on ecosystems.

notes:
{森林伐採|しんりんばっさい} refers to the large-scale removal of forests for timber, agriculture, or development. It is a major environmental concern due to its impact on biodiversity and climate.
